units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 29:7">Kel. XXIX, 7</cite> <he>יד בן הפ׳</he> the handle of a small hammer; <he>של הפ׳</he> of the sledge-hammer.

<cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 5:15">Maas. Sh. V, 15</cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 11a:9">M. Kat. 11ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>עד ימיו היה פ׳ מכה בירושלם</he> up to his day the striking of the hammer was heard in Jerusalem (during the festive week).
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:14">Cant. R. to V, 14</cite>, a. e. <he>נחלק הפ׳</he> the sledge-hammer (striking on the sapphire) was shivered to pieces.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 34a:12">Snh. 34ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 88b:3">Sabb. 88ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00751"><he>נִיצוֹץ</he></cite>; a. fr.—

Ib. VII, 2 המכה בפ׳ he who gives the finishing stroke with the hammer; ib. 75ᵇ כל מידי דאית ביה גמר מלאכה חייב משום מכה בפ׳ any act of finishing up a work comes under the category of striking with the hammer; a. fr.—Trnsf. great character.
<cite ref="Berakhot 28b:8">Ber. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>נר ישראל … פ׳ החזק</he> thou light of Israel, right-hand pillar, powerful hammer!
